name: L-Train x Chef Mario | 200mg Infused Olive Oil | Hot Honey
description: Experience the perfect harmony of rich wildflower honey and potent Manuka honey with a bold hint of hot pepper. This premium blend delivers smooth floral sweetness, powerful benefits, and a warm, invigorating kick in every spoonful. Drizzle it on toast, stir into tea, glaze over chef Mario's pizza or wings, dress over any ice cream or enjoy with your favorite snacks. Bold. Balanced. Buzzworthy.
